Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("OPENAI_API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(client, "{\"max_tokens\":50,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}") |> Enum.to_list()
IO.inspect(result)
```
